findings.title: Separate final/preserved collection payloads violate duplicate-bulk admission
findings.description: Both exact-revision bound collection artifacts recover the same 3,345,163-byte raw object with SHA256 f5071343d0ab13e4909a39077eea753bd01ab7956cde2f18b72dbaf436a2cb0d, but use separate same-directory gzip payload paths (400,494 bytes each). The unchanged storage audit rejects duplicate raw bulk in distinct payloads at or above 16 KiB. This violates the execution packet required final exact-head zero-error storage audit even though the aggregate numerical budget and corrected execution checks pass. Preserve the earlier real failure/source/review bindings; correct the new evidence generation/admission without rewriting outputs, waiving duplicate-bulk, or promoting historical collection to a new tested execution. A new concrete revision needs fresh evidence/result/reviews as required by its scope.
findings.independent_proof: Retrieved both regular envelope/payload pairs at the exact reviewed SHA with each original tested SHA, command and exit; bytes are exactly equal and the payload paths are different. This satisfies the actual audit duplicate-bulk predicate at tools/harness/compact_evidence.py:1379.

independently_verified_semantics: Declared codec alone selects bounded decoder. Gzip remains default and retains single-member guards; XZ pins FORMAT_XZ, CRC64 and preset 6. XZ checks exact stored length/hash, fixed 64 MiB memory, declared raw length plus one output bound, EOF, no unused bytes, exact raw length/hash and nested storage rejection.

Both codecs preserve raw execution bytes and command/tested SHA/exit/timestamp/count fields; failed execution remains failed. Regular same-revision Git objects, same-owner same-directory payload identity, tested ancestry, missing objects and integrity failures remain fail-closed. Plain UTF encodings and harmless ordinary scalar metadata names stay compatible.

Explicit reencoding validates all inputs before mutation, selects full existing ancestor source, denies protected-base/plain/archival/foreign/invalid input, preserves raw identity and every execution field, and pins original/replacement envelope and payload Git blob IDs, hashes and lengths. Source reads remain at original revision; replacement reads remain at bound revision. Obsolete payload removal requires every current reference accounted for. Maps cannot be rewritten or reused for a second conversion.

Audit inspects each commit and every parent edge. Globally inherited maps reverify original and replacement snapshots with their admitted owner/base; post-admission transient deletion/change/restoration cannot disappear. Global changed-blob classification includes pre-admission branches, renamed/wrapped/nested/UTF metadata and payload-suffix aliases. New foreign mapping and protected-ancestry foreign compact mutation reject. Pre-admission side branches need no retroactive admitted map.

Narrow binary JSON/encoding classification exemption requires full exact-revision bound payload retrieval; no later revision or invalid sibling can prove a payload. Size/type/integrity and later map/mutation guards remain enforced. HG051 archive reader/schema/inventory remain isolated and cannot supply execution PASS.

Task and governance suffixes reject existing representation mutations and conversion records even under own bookkeeping directories, including restoration. New independent captured review output remains allowed under the linear REVIEW_RECORD_ONLY contract. Semantic M3 execution oracles remain intact; C10 tests explicitly verify direct nested shape rejection, source-suffix rejection and exact stale M3 rejection order.

No frozen table, invariant or T1-T8 atomic boundary is changed. No command owner/direct-write bypass, authorization elevation, production/shadow binding, planning-as-actual fill or model/network wait in coordination transactions is introduced. Storage proof grants no product or execution authority.
